Parliament Monsoon Session Begins Amidst Opposition Focus on NEET, Other Issues

India's Parliament is set to commence its Monsoon Session, with the opposition planning to raise several key issues including the NEET exam paper leak and alleged Ram Mandir scams. The government is expected to introduce new legislation, while discussions around potential reforms and national issues are anticipated. The session's proceedings will be closely watched for political maneuvering and legislative outcomes.
